<function name="SetControlPointParent" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>Essentially makes child control point follow the parent control point.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="childID" type="number">The child control point ID, 0 to 63.</arg>
		<arg name="parentID" type="number">The parent control point ID, 0 to 63.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
